csv_scope_of_work: The Municipality of Anchorage (MOA), Solid Waste Services (SWS) Department, seeks proposals from qualified firms to provide Operations and Maintenance at Risk (OMAR) advisory services in support of the planning and design of a Waste-toEnergy (WTE) facility. The selected OMAR firm will provide operational input and guidance to inform facility design decisions, with emphasis on long-term operational success, including operability, safety, maintainability, reliability, and regulatory compliance. Partnerships/subcontracting arrangements are encouraged where the combined value of parties involved adds to the total experience and ability of the proposer; however, MOA will require to engage with a single firm or entity with business operations in Alaska and an Alaskan registered office.
